name: modwerk-test-on-unit
description: Test a Modwerk build on the developer's instrument over USB in two stages - first the tests the agent runs on the unit itself (npm run test:procedure: the fixed steps from the software checks to a rolled-back trial, then by hand and the change's own edge cases), then the developer's own test of what only a person can judge - or, without a unit, in the emulator. Use when a developer wants to try, test or qualify a module or base on hardware or in the emulator, or another command needs a build tested on the unit.
